findings.evidence: Lines 67–71 compose `MonoidAlgebra.scalarTensorBialgEquiv` and `MonoidAlgebra.groupLikeEquiv`; their confirmed signatures require only a commutative monoid/monoid, while `DiagonalizableGroup.coordinateRing` accepts every `G : FGCommGrpCat`.
findings.fix: First define the equivalence `geometricCharacterGroup (DiagonalizableGroup.coordinateRing k G).obj ≃* G` for arbitrary `G : FGCommGrpCat` in the diagonalizable/multiplicative-type layer, then derive the split-torus additive specialization from it.
findings.issue: `splitTorusGeometricCharacterGroupEquiv` and the derived additive equivalence at line 75 hard-code `Multiplicative (ULift (Fin n) →₀ ℤ)`, although the proof only uses the coordinate ring of an arbitrary `G : FGCommGrpCat`.

summary: The split-torus character equivalences are unnecessarily specialized to finite free character groups despite their construction working for every diagonalizable group.
